subject: Warmup rampbook + tempo uplift request — FastRetail pilot
messages:
From: LaunchOps <launchops@fastretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Bloom <sarah@fastretail.com>, procurements@fastretail.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Warmup rampbook + tempo uplift request — FastRetail pilot

Hi Jonas,

We’re finalizing the pilot launch schedule for FastRetail’s holiday feature test and need a short-term uplift to our token quota during the 2-week warmup window (Nov 10–24). Attached is our per-hour forecast by region and a short “ramp playbook” outlining traffic cadence and rollback triggers. High-level asks:

- Temporary inbound token uplift to cover peak warmup days: ~1.1M tokens/day peak (US), tapering to baseline by day 15.
- A soft-burst allowance for the first 48 hours if we exceed queued latency tolerances.
- Confirmation on fallbacks: which model variants you’ll route to if the primary quota fills (we’d prefer Llama-2-13B q8 compat fallbacks).

We’ll need approvals this week to keep our onboarding calendar intact. I copied procurement for any SOW/DocuSign steps.

Attachments: fastretail_warmup_forecast_20280630.csv, fastretail_ramp_playbook_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Carver
LaunchOps (FastRetail)
launchops@fastretail.com

---

Subject: Re: Warmup rampbook + tempo uplift request — FastRetail pilot

Jonas/Karthik — quick read of the CSV. Observations and product asks: 

- The US peak is a 6-hour plateau (08:00–14:00 PT) not a single spike. That aligns well with batching optimizations but will raise peak concurrent token generation.
- Product needs a clarified rollback trigger for the customer: suggesting two thresholds — 1) sustained token consumption >120% of uplift for 30m, 2) 95th pctl latency >450ms for 5m. We can wire automated routing to a smaller quantized model when triggers fire.

Product asks (to Karthik/Infra):
- Can infra allocate a temporary soft-burst pool for the first 48 hours (buffer of ~250k tokens/day) scoped to the FastRetail account?
- If not, can we preconfigure a model-variant fallback chain: redwood/llama-2-13b-q8 -> redwood/llama-2-13b-int8 -> redwood/7b-q4?

Irene — can you confirm if a manual canary (10% traffic) is doable for the first 12 hours? Naomi, flagging for CS runbook updates.

-Marissa
Product Manager, Launch Reliability
marissa@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warmup rampbook + tempo uplift request — FastRetail pilot

Thanks — digging into numbers. Quick operational plan below (draft):

- Proposed uplift window: Nov 9 00:00 UTC -> Nov 25 00:00 UTC (2-week warmup + 24h buffer).
- Uplift amounts (US regional buckets): baseline -> temporary +1.2M tokens/day (covers peak and headroom). We can carve this from burst pool but need approval from capacity finance (linked Jira ENG-1426).
- Soft-burst policy: allow 48h transient overshoot up to 20% above uplift in exchange for priority preemptible capacity; we’ll bill standard overage rates.
- Canary: 10% traffic in first 12h, escalate to 50% after 6h if latency & error budget OK.

Product/infrastructure asks:
- Marissa: confirm fallback chain order (q8 -> int8 -> q4).
- Irene: confirm we can toggle canary weighting from Console and have tracing tags for FR requests.
- Naomi: draft a short CS comms template in case the customer sees an automated fallback.

I’ll open the internal quota-exception ticket and attach the forecast. If approvals come back by Thu EOD, I can schedule the uplift change for Nov 8 maintenance window.

-Karthik
Head of Infra Operations (redwood)
karthik@redwood.com

Alex / Sarah — quick update and next steps from Redwood: 

- We provisionally approve a temporary uplift for Nov 9–25 as requested.
- Provisioned uplift: +1.2M tokens/day (US), with a 48h soft-burst allowance (20% overshoot) subject to overage billing.
- Canary: we’ll route 10% traffic for the first 12h, shift to 50% after health checks at 6h if metrics look good.
- Fallback chain: redwood/llama-2-13b-q8 -> redwood/llama-2-13b-int8 -> redwood/7b-q4. Automated routing will kick in on the triggers Marissa proposed.

Action items:
- FastRetail: confirm you accept the overage billing terms and DocuSign SOW (link in my signature).
- Redwood: Karthik will open the quota-exception ticket and Irene will prepare the canary toggles and tracing tags. Naomi will send the CS comms.

I’ll mark this as tentative pending procurement sign-off and DocuSign execution. Thanks for the fast turnaround on the forecast — that made routing the uplift straightforward.

Best,
